summary: Extends PPPoE with a credit-based flow control mechanism and a link quality metric report. It is meant to improve performance over media such as mobile radio with variable bandwidth and limited buffering. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 5578.

eli5.summary: Over a bumpy wireless link, a sender should only send what the receiver has room for. This adds a way to give out space credits and report link quality.

how does pppoe handle variable bandwidth
